scale: 0-5 per criterion (0 absent, 3 acceptable, 5 excellent). Score by LOOKING at the actual output image (display_file / vision), never from the prompt.

thumbnail_read.desc: At ~120px the signature hair + standout feature are instantly recognizable (squint test)

selection_fidelity.desc: Every taxonomy pick is visibly present (hair, hair colour, build, distinctive, outfit, accessory)

deadpan_sincerity.desc: Expression deadpan/earnest per card; no wink, no big grin

photoreal_texture.desc: Pores, hair strands, fabric texture; no plastic/waxy skin (tier total may exaggerate shape but not texture)

framing.desc: Full body head-to-toe, 9:16, clean light-grey backdrop, feet and head not cropped

anatomy.desc: Hands, fingers, eyes coherent (intended exaggeration excluded)

originality_safety.desc: Does not resemble a real person/celebrity; humour from styling not from mocking ethnicity/body

identity_preserved.desc: Face, hair, body identical to parent run

requested_change.desc: Only the requested change happened, and it happened

layout.desc: 5 full-body turnaround (front, 3/4 front, side, 3/4 back, back) + 3 close-ups; thin dividers; no text/labels

cross_panel_identity.desc: Same face, hair, outfit, props and colours in every panel

photoreal_texture.desc: Consistent lighting and texture across panels

ref_match.desc: Same character as sheet (hair, face, outfit or intended outfit swap only)

format_hook.desc: First-frame hook readable: movement/face/text reason not to scroll

safe_zone.desc: Face in upper-middle safe zone of 9:16, away from UI overlays

photoreal_texture.desc: Native UGC phone look or intended style

hair_drift.fix: Move hair to the first descriptive line, add shape+length+parting+fringe words, repeat hair anchor in drift guard

feature_missing.fix: State the standout feature twice (Face line + Character notes) with size words (e.g. 'thick coke-bottle lenses that magnify the eyes')

smile_leak.fix: Add 'lips closed, mouth neutral, no smile' to Face line; keep 'big grin' in negative

plastic_skin.fix: Add 'visible pores, fine vellus hair, slight skin imperfections'; switch to a higher-realism model

cropped_body.fix: Add 'full body head to toe with space above head and below feet'; use 9:16 or 2:3

background_busy.fix: Repeat 'plain seamless light-grey backdrop'; remove scene nouns

identity_drift.fix: Use edit/reference mode with the locked ref; edit prompt must say 'keep everything identical except X'

sheet_layout.fix: Spell out the two-row layout with numbered panels; add 'clean thin white dividing lines, no text'

panel_inconsistency.fix: Paste the full CHARACTER paragraph verbatim; add 'must match exactly in every panel'

anatomy_hands.fix: Arms hanging by sides, hands relaxed; add hand terms to negative

tier_mismatch.fix: Average: 'natural proportions'; Extreme: name the exaggerated feature explicitly with scale words

lookalike_risk.fix: Change 2+ facial anchors (nose, brows, face shape) and re-run; never mention real names

stereotype_risk.fix: Remove ethnicity-linked jokes; keep humour in styling/posture/attitude

text_artifacts.fix: Keep 'text, watermark, logo' in negative; no labels in sheet

model_refused.fix: Remove sensitive words, switch provider, report real error
